name: How long does a typical stucco remediation project take?
description: Stucco remediation duration varies by project size and damage extent, from a few days for minor repairs to several weeks for larger homes.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical stucco remediation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a stucco remediation project varies significantly based on the scope of work, the size of the building, and the extent of underlying damage. A smaller repair might take a few days, while a full-scale re-stucco project on a larger home could extend to several weeks or even a few months. Factors like weather conditions, material availability, and the need for structural repairs can also influence the timeline. A detailed assessment from a qualified contractor will provide a more accurate estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco remediation duration varies by project size and damage extent, from a few days for minor repairs to several weeks for larger homes.
